decisions.reason: Its dedicated website page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests performance at or above aspiration levels, so even a small firm is likely to retain it.
Its continued presence across two years indicates acceptable results, though lower prominence than A implies a somewhat higher risk if it falls short of aspirations.
As the newest product it is still in an uncertainty period, and despite limited slack in a small firm the usual behavioral response is to give it a bit more time unless results clearly disappoint.
